title: Send a guest to sign-in when opening a record
preconditions: The local app is running with the seeded database and the doctor check passes.

steps.action: Open /experiences and activate the first record card.
steps.expected: The browser lands on /login with callbackUrl set to the record path, and the record content is not shown.

steps.action: Open a legacy record URL of the form /experiences/exp_001 directly.
steps.expected: The same sign-in redirect happens and callbackUrl preserves the legacy path.

risk: Read-only. Do not attempt to forge a session to get past the gate.
